svg.title: A self-exciting downgrade intensity
svg.desc: The intensity of an obligor's next transition in dos Reis, Pfeuffer and Smith's momentum model: the Markov baseline of its current grade plus a term that jumps by beta times alpha at each downgrade and decays at rate beta (alpha = beta = 1 here).
svg.text: Intensity of the next transition, baseline plus momentum (alpha = beta = 1)
